method: Rows from PSI experimental tables that report both O₂ and pressure (harmonized to % and kPa). 'Moon region' = ambient O₂ ≥ 30% and pressure ≤ 70.3 kPa (10.2 psi), as stated in the challenge. Inverse-flame rows (O₂ is the burner oxidizer stream, not the cabin atmosphere) are plotted but excluded from the ambient counts. Set-point lists and ranges are plotted at their mid-point with error bars.
limitations: PSI contains no partial-gravity (lunar/Martian) combustion data; all points are microgravity tests.
Gaseous, droplet and solid-fuel configurations are shown together for coverage only, not for comparing results.
Several investigations (BASS, BASS-II, Saffire, SPICE) do not report pressure per row and are absent from this map.
